title: add() returns wrong sum for negative numbers
description: Our billing adjustment job uses your calculator.add helper. add(-2, 3) returns -5 but we expect 1. Positive inputs are wrong too: add(2, 3) gives -1 instead of 5. This started after we upgraded.

title: App crashes on empty input
description: Sometimes the app crashes when a field is submitted empty. We cannot give exact steps and it does not happen every time. Please investigate.
